capabilities: Trigger AI responses by typing assistant tags or picking them from the command list
Chat with LLM providers including Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter and Ollama
Analyze embedded images and PDF files with vision-capable models
Generate and edit images with GPT-Image-1
Export conversations to JSONL datasets for ms-swift fine-tuning
extras: Named after the robot Tars from the movie Interstellar. The FAQ covers HTTP error codes, third-party baseUrl configuration, and rendering performance advice such as switching to Source mode for long outputs. Conversation syntax rules apply: one message per paragraph, callouts are excluded from prompts, and a NewChat tag starts a new conversation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with large language models or generate AI text directly in notes, and configuring multiple AI providers requires separate tooling.

relations.evidence: We recommend using the colored tags plugin.

summary: AI text generation plugin that runs LLM conversations inside notes using tag-based triggers, with support for Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama and many other providers.
